# Healthcare Spec Section

Write the regulatory, privacy and safety section of a PRD, BRD or feature spec for a healthcare product: determine whether the feature handles protected health information, then write, for each PHI flow, the safeguards (minimum necessary access, authentication, encryption, audit logging, retention and deletion, business associate agreements), consent and patient rights, de-identification for analytics, interoperability notes (HL7 or FHIR), the clinical influence assessment — flagged for clinical safety and software-as-a-medical-device review where it applies — and the numbered questions for privacy, security and clinical reviewers. A review draft ready to paste into the spec, ending "Not legal or regulatory advice"; it never declares a feature compliant or exempt, and never uses real patient data in examples.
